s24.title: Post-Season reflect: How was Rebuilt, post 145

auto.text: An analyst says it cut in front of a slower opponent and went around, leaving one corner but clearing more of its side. The contact upset 2910's auto in two matches; in finals 1 the robot beached instead.

cycle.text: At Central Valley an analyst saw it stop passing about 10 seconds before its shift to fill the hopper, then shoot on the move while collecting.
On Einstein it and 4414 swept the neutral zone, leaving little fuel there for opponents.

changed.text: It stopped in auto of Einstein finals 1, came back and stopped again, a commenter says; a reviewer puts the loss of that match down to the breakdown. Two others had heard, without being sure, of a loose battery terminal or lead.
A commenter says blocking was not viable until a rule change a few weeks before the championship; a reply says it was only riskier before.

outcome.text: 69-4-0 in official play; won the Daly division, won the championship; pick 1 of the Daly alliance on Einstein; ranked 6 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 331.99, Daly).

solves.text: Shoot and pass without stopping in one place

facts.text: A commenter describes a turreted dye rotor with a shot blocker
Analysts saw it shoot on the move, and pass fuel back to its own side while sweeping the neutral zone
A commenter lists it in March among turret robots with low-inertia flywheels, which the commenter says change speed in well under 70 ms
Before Einstein a commenter said turrets like those of 4414 and 1323 match drum shooters in effective rate, as they lose less time aligning; another said the best drums do shoot faster
A season reviewer calls its four-bar linkage intake unique

solves.text: Keep stored fuel inside the robot instead of in the alliance zone

facts.text: A commenter says it stockpiles fuel inside the robot, in a netted hopper much bigger than those of drum shooters because of chamfered corners

functions.name: Bumpers
functions.type: bumpers with a small bottom fillet

facts.text: 254 says 1323's bumpers at Central Valley inspired the smaller bottom fillet on its own later bumpers, so as not to surf on fuel

functions.name: Shot blocker
functions.type: part that extends up to block opponents' shots

facts.text: A clip is described as the robot extending up and blocking all the shots of a dumper

decisions.choice: Bring out shot blockers with 4065 in Einstein match 8
decisions.because: a commenter says it countered high-scoring opponents instead of only trying to outscore them; another says the threat alone slowed opponents, and that blocking one fuel stream made all the shots collide and miss
decisions.cost: another commenter says a blocker is difficult to engineer and drive, and needs everything to go right
